canonical_project: Doma/STP Green Data Center Park - Chonburi/EEC
owner: Doma Infrastructure Group; Silicon Tech Park
notes: Silicon Tech Park and trade sources describe a 1.5 GW, three-park EEC program across Chachoengsao, Chonburi, and Rayong, with first facilities targeted for Q3 2026. Capacity shown here is an inferred one-third allocation for the Chonburi park; sources do not state a Pattaya-city site, and DCD characterizes the sites as outside Bangkok and Pattaya City.
